entries.description: Homestead farming bees, honey, and rare poultry breeds, offering apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture, and producing lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name Armadillo Mountain.
entries.raw_text: oriented homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry. Off-farm income is derived from graphic design, photography and writing for the organic agriculture journals. We also produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain. Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land. Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems) for some good, solid vocational skills, especially carpentry and stone masonry. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.
entries.notes: Continuation from previous page; community_name left blank and continues_previous set to 'yes' per codebook. Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians, 22 acres') with work exchanges/apprenticeships. Accepted groups inferred from 'Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land.' Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry'), Workshops/education ('Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture'), Archives/cultural work ('produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain'), and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Permaculture', 'writing for the organic agriculture journals'). num_residents left blank because this page segment does not include 'women living on the land', though '2 lesbians' is noted.

entries.description: Two lesbians caretaking 147 acres in Days Creek, Oregon, seeking new members, caretakers, and contributions to revive an inactive women's and children's community.
entries.raw_text: OWL FARM POB 133, Days Creek, OR 97429. We are two wimmin caretaking OWL since Aug 82. OWL is needing energy and money support from wimmin to stay open for wimmin & children. No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence. I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here. We welcome: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained, donations. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 147 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because the resident caretakers are actively recruiting new members ('We welcome: new members/caretakers... Inactive group with hopes to revive'). Land city and state inferred from mailing address and caretaking of OWL in Days Creek, OR. num_residents is 2 based on '2 lesbians' and 'wimmin living and working the land'. Accepted groups include Boy children with restriction ('under 10 years') and Non-lesbian women as stated. Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence') and Women of color ('I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here').

entries.description: Land trust purchasing OWL Farm in Days Creek, Oregon, supported by donations and holding quarterly meetings at the farm caretaken by a fluctuating women's collective.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470. OWLT is in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above). Support for the farm and trust comes from donations from those women who believe in land for women. A quarterly newsletter is printed, $5/year. Land trust meetings are held about every three months at the farm. A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust as stated in the name and description. Land location inferred from OWL Farm in Days Creek, OR ('buying OWL FARM (see above)... meetings are held about every three months at the farm'). Acreage left blank as not specified in this listing text. num_residents left blank because 'the number fluctuates'. Accepted groups from 'We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women' plus Lesbian women.

entries.description: A family of four lesbians living on 40 acres on a secluded forest hilltop in Myrtle Creek, Oregon, growing food, creating art and song, and offering seasonal workshops in Theatre and Tai Chi.
entries.raw_text: FLY AWAY HOME POB 593, Myrtle Creek, OR 97457. We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop. We grow food and tender our emotional and spiritual depths. And we make art and song that celebrate woman. We invite women to our workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi several times during the year. We are unable to welcome visitors at other times. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative for 'a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop'. Land city and state inferred from mailing address. num_residents is 4 from 'family of 4 lesbians living' and 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted groups include Non-lesbian women per pre-1986 rule for 'invite women to our workshops'. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('We grow food'), Spirituality/ritual ('tender our emotional and spiritual depths'), Workshops/education ('workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi'), and Archives/cultural work ('make art and song that celebrate woman').

entries.description: A partnership of two lesbians owning 130 forested acres in Roseburg, Oregon, practicing timber management and firewood harvesting, with a cabin, garden, and animals.
entries.raw_text: STEPPING WOODS Rt 4 Box 1058, Roseburg, OR 97470. We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property. We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest and firewood. There is one woman-built cabin, a few out buildings, a garden, chickens, and pets. We are not separatists and have male friends that come on our land. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land per the two-woman rule ('partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres'). Rural route mailing address indicates the land address. num_residents is 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted groups from 'We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women' plus Lesbian women. Visiting friends ('have male friends that come on our land') are not coded as accepted groups per codebook. Separatism rejected ('We are not separatists') so not coded as a focus.

entries.description: A rural feminist publishing center producing WomanSpirit and The Blatant Image on 6+ acres in Sunny Valley, Oregon, run by two lesbians ages 57 and 60, offering photography workshops and welcoming women for visits and project work.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mountain Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. A rural feminist publishing center (WomanSpirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography, (summer Ovulars), ecology and alternative technology. We are 57 & 60 years old. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. Rules: no men, guns, pets, drugs or dope. Smoking limited to outdoors gravel area. $4/day/woman includes vegetarian meals. We welcome: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 6+ acres, housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', ages 57 & 60) welcoming short or long visits to help on projects rather than collective ownership. Street address indicates land address. Acreage recorded as 6 from '6+ acres'. num_residents is 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working with the land'. Accepted groups include Non-lesbian women as stated; men explicitly excluded ('Rules: no men'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('Rules: ... drugs or dope'), Archives/cultural work ('publishing center (WomanSpirit and The Blatant Image)'), Workshops/education ('(summer Ovulars)'), and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('ecology and alternative technology'). Older women not coded as they welcome 'women of all ages'.

entries.description: Notice reporting that Ozark Wimmin's Land Trust attempted multiple-ownership land holding, but the land eventually wound up in legal dissolution, while members persevere in spirit.
entries.raw_text: OZARK WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 718, Fayetteville, AR 72702. We have tried multiple-ownership (partnership) type of land holding. The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually. Some of us persevere in the spirit. We cannot guarantee to answer letters, but if you are prepared to spend a little time in the area, a land search may be fruitful. A large wimmin's community exists.
entries.notes: Not a listing. The listing reports that 'The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually.' No type, acreage, or residents recorded per codebook instructions for ended communities.
